title: Evaluating and improving AI agents for sequencing protocol understanding
abstract: arXiv:2610.37851v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing scientific-agent benchmarks rarely evaluate whether agents can reconstruct the exact molecular structures and generation workflows specified by sequencing protocols, a capability critical for analyzing customized sequencing assays. We introduce LibStructBench, a document-grounded benchmark for reconstructing sequencing-library structures and molecular workflows. Our experiments show that frontier agents often produce approximately correct reconstructions but remain unreliable at exact reconstruction, particularly in molecular-state representation and workflow connectivity. Switching the underlying language model produced larger average performance differences than switching agent harnesses, with a statistically significant difference only for molecular-state reconstruction. Additional knowledge improved oligo-family recovery in a small pilot without improving mean molecular-workflow scores. Autonomous accumulation of procedural

translated_title: 评估与改进用于测序方案理解的AI智能体
translated_abstract: 现有的科学智能体基准测试很少评估智能体能否精确重构测序方案所规定的分子结构和生成工作流程，而这一能力对于分析定制化测序实验至关重要。我们提出了LibStructBench，一个基于文档的基准测试，用于重构测序文库结构和分子工作流程。我们的实验表明，前沿智能体通常能产生大致正确的重构结果，但在精确重构方面仍不可靠，尤其是在分子状态表示和工作流程连通性方面。更换底层语言模型比更换智能体框架产生了更大的平均性能差异，且仅在分子状态重构方面存在统计学显著差异。在小规模试点中，额外的知识提高了寡核苷酸家族的恢复率，但没有提高平均分子工作流程得分。自主积累程序性……
tldr: 该论文提出了LibStructBench——一个基于文档的基准测试，用于评估AI智能体精确重构测序方案所规定的分子结构和工作流程的能力，发现前沿智能体虽能实现大致正确的重构，但在精确重构（尤其是分子状态表示和工作流程连通性）方面仍不可靠。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces LibStructBench, a document-grounded benchmark for evaluating AI agents' ability to exactly reconstruct sequencing-library structures and molecular workflows, showing that frontier agents achieve approximate but not exact reconstructions, particularly failing in molecular-state representation and workflow connectivity.
